cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(qtbug147602repro LANGUAGES C CXX OBJCXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_OBJCXX_STANDARD 20)
add_library(uncached_colorspace SHARED uncached_colorspace.c)
target_link_libraries(uncached_colorspace PRIVATE "-framework CoreGraphics" "-framework CoreFoundation")
if(NOT SHIM_ONLY)
  find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets)
  add_executable(repro repro.mm)
  target_link_libraries(repro PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets "-framework CoreGraphics")
endif()
